content.text: All stresses pass well within budget. Final tree verification and evaluator-style invocation from an arbitrary cwd:

arguments.command:
cd / && python3 -I -B /workspace/project/campaign_cli.py < /workspace/examples/smoke.input.json | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('records:', d['records'])" && cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'EOF'
import os, stat
total = 0; entries = 0; bad = []
for root, dirs, files in os.walk('.'):
    for name in dirs + files:
        p = os.path.join(root, name)
        info = os.lstat(p)
        entries += 1
        if stat.S_ISLNK(info.st_mode) or not (stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or stat.S_ISDIR(info.st_mode)):
            bad.append(p)
        if stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode):
            if info.st_nlink != 1: bad.append((p, 'hardlink'))
            total += info.st_size
print("bytes:", total, "entries:", entries, "bad:", bad)
assert total <= 8 * 1024 * 1024 and entries <= 256 and not bad
print("tree bounds OK")
EOF
find /workspace/project | sort
